instructors.name: Ben Dwyer
instructors.bio:
Benjamin Dwyer is the President and Co-Owner of Direct Connect Flight Academy, where he leads the organization's strategic vision and oversees its commitment to delivering exceptional flight training. With more than 25 years of professional aviation experience, Ben is dedicated to developing safe, skilled, and confident pilots while fostering a culture built on integrity, professionalism, and operational excellence.
Since launching his professional flying career in 2000, Ben has built an accomplished career spanning airline, corporate, and charter aviation. He has flown the Beechcraft 1900, CRJ-200, Airbus A320 family, and the Pilatus PC-12, providing him with a well-rounded perspective across diverse flight operations.
In addition to his extensive flying experience, Ben has held numerous leadership positions with a major airline over the past 20 years, including Airbus Fleet Manager, Flight Operations Duty Manager, Technical Pilot, and Director of Flight Standards. These roles have allowed him to lead pilot training, operational standardization, regulatory compliance, and safety initiatives while mentoring flight crews and shaping organizational performance.
Ben also serves as Chief Pilot for a Part 135 Pilatus PC-12 operation and is a Pilatus PC-12 owner, providing him with firsthand experience in aircraft ownership, business aviation, and operational leadership. This unique combination of executive leadership, line flying, aircraft ownership, and Part 135 management gives him a practical understanding of every aspect of aviation—from flight training to advanced commercial operations.
A graduate of Metropolitan State University of Denver with a degree in Aviation Technology, Ben is passionate about preparing the next generation of aviation professionals. Under his leadership, Direct Connect Flight Academy has become known for its unwavering commitment to safety, excellence, and student success, equipping pilots with the knowledge, discipline, and confidence needed to thrive in today's aviation industry.
Ben believes that aviation is more than learning to fly. It's about developing sound judgment, professionalism, and leadership. His vision is for every student who walks through Direct Connect Flight Academy's doors to leave not only as a capable pilot, but as a trusted aviation professional prepared to excel throughout their career.

instructors.name: Frank Schultz
instructors.bio:
Frank Schultz is the Vice President and Co-Owner of Direct Connect Flight Academy and professional pilot himself. He plays a key role in advancing the school's mission of providing exceptional flight training and developing the next generation of aviation professionals. With more than three decades of aviation experience, Frank is committed to helping students build the knowledge, skills, and confidence necessary for successful careers in aviation.

Frank's passion for flying began in Colorado at the age of 16 and ultimately led him to earn a degree in Aviation and Aerospace Science from Metropolitan State University of Denver. Since beginning his professional flying career, he has accumulated extensive experience across a wide range of aviation operations. His career started flying skydivers in a historic Beech 18 before moving on to conduct sightseeing flights over the Grand Canyon. He later advanced to regional airline operations in California and went on to fly the DC-9 for AirTran Airways, the Boeing 757 for National Airlines and ATA Airlines, and the Boeing 747 for Tradewinds Airlines.

For the past 21 years, Frank has served as a Captain on the Airbus A320 family at Frontier Airlines. In addition to his line flying responsibilities, he serves as an Aircrew Program Designee (APD), where he evaluates and mentors airline pilots while helping maintain the highest standards of safety, training, and operational excellence. His extensive airline experience provides students with valuable real-world insight into the skills and professionalism required to succeed in today's aviation industry.

Throughout his career, Frank has remained passionate about aviation education and mentorship. As a co-owner of Direct Connect Flight Academy, he takes pride in helping aspiring pilots navigate their training journey, from their first flight lesson through the pursuit of professional flying careers. His combination of flight training experience, airline leadership, and operational expertise allows him to provide students with practical guidance rooted in decades of industry experience.

Frank has been married to his wife, Karissa, for more than 31 years. Together they have raised two children, both of whom have pursued careers connected to aviation and public service. Frank believes that successful pilots are defined not only by their technical skills, but also by their character, judgment, and commitment to continuous learning. His goal is to help every student at Direct Connect Flight Academy develop the professionalism, confidence, and decision-making abilities needed to excel throughout their aviation career.

instructors.name: Karissa Schultz
instructors.bio:
Karissa Schultz coordinates ATP-CTP ground school and simulator scheduling, ensuring a smooth and organized experience for every student from enrollment to completion.

Though not a pilot, Karissa has spent over 31 years married to one, gaining a deep appreciation for aviation and the dedication it requires. She and her husband, Frank Schultz (Co-owner of DCFA and an aviation professional), have spent the past decade building Direct Connect Flight Academy with their team into one of the country's best Part141 flight schools! 

Karissa is especially passionate about supporting military veterans as they transition into aviation careers. She believes DCFA’s strength lies in its people; from dedicated instructors to motivated students and a welcoming, supportive culture.

Proud parents of two children: Megan, who works in aviation at Textron, and Zach, who serves on active duty in the U.S. Navy.

Outside of work, Karissa enjoys traveling, cooking, spending time outdoors, and making memories with family and friends.
